title: The stock market’s most hated rally keeps getting stronger
title_zh: 股市最令人讨厌的反弹持续走强
summary: Key markets, including the S&P 500, Nasdaq Composite, Russell 2000, and Dow Transports are all at fresh records. That makes this look less like a bounce off the mat and more like a market that keeps refusing to back down.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克综合指数、罗素 2000 指数和道指运输指数等主要市场均创下新纪录。这使得这看起来不像是从垫子上反弹，而更像是一个不断拒绝退缩的市场。

title: The software rebound is real, but not every big name is back: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 软件反弹是真实的，但并非每个大牌都回来了：每日图表
summary: Software stocks just posted their best week in two and a half decades.
summary_zh: 软件股刚刚创下了二十五年来最好的一周表现。

title: What the Allbirds 'Hail Mary' says about the AI trade right now
title_zh: Allbirds 的“万福玛丽”对目前人工智能行业的评价
summary: Allbirds' AI pivot shows signs of froth in markets, but experts say the underlying fundamentals in AI remain strong.
summary_zh: Allbirds 的人工智能转型显示出市场泡沫的迹象，但专家表示，人工智能的基本面仍然强劲。

title: Morning Brief: The future of Netflix is now
title_zh: 早间简报：Netflix 的未来就在眼前
summary: The stock market put in another surge on Friday to close out a week of record highs.
summary_zh: 周五股市再次飙升，创下一周历史新高。

title: Tesla stock snaps 8-week losing streak with earnings ahead
title_zh: 特斯拉股价结束八周连跌，财报即将公布
summary: Tesla stock rose in early trade and is poised to finish the week higher and snap an eight-week losing streak. The rebound in the stock comes as earnings approach next Wednesday.
summary_zh: 特斯拉股价早盘上涨，本周有望收高，结束八周连续下跌。随着下周三财报临近，该股出现反弹。
